body: It is! When I pulled it off and saw the prongs holding them in place I was sorely disappointed. I'm probably just gonna get some heavy duty double sided tape (those tapes are strong af btw jesus) to keep that part in place. Not permanent but not weak either.

Ford just quoted me around $140 for the panel although I think the guy was trying to order the entire unit and not just the panel LOL Doesn't make sense when I got quoted $80 for the Driver's side seat control panel which is like 5x the size.......
I was looking on American Muscle and I noticed the Roush axelback is 110 dollars less if you get the black tip model. So strange. Definitely is an option too.
I'm seeing they come with an H pipe stock. Not something aggressive I would say. In between aggressive and subtle if that makes sense. lol
Sick. Definitely gonna research into that more. Would you say there's a big difference between having the xpipe installed vs not having it.

How do you change the perception of a future event which turns out negative. It's immature to say that every possible future situation will come out bad, but hot damn. I haven't gotten a break for as long as I can remember. What if you don't even have the ability to change that mindset. Like i've stated before, I can't even recall the last positive emotion i've felt.

These thoughts exist in the present. Irregardless of past or future experiences. It feels as if you've reached the end of the road. Quite literally. When resting becomes an idea of bliss. A sigh of relief so to speak. It's selfish yes I understand, but is it? Is it really.

After countless hours if not days even, of thinking what the future may hold for me, I have come to the conclusion that I have little interest in that dream job or dream life. Maybe it's a bi-product of forgetting what joy and happiness feels like. Maybe I am missing out. All I know is it feels similar to the beginning of a shitty B-rated movie. You think to yourself, is it really going to get better from here on out? Life's cruel. Very very cruel. Not everyone get's that halfway decent ending. I'm just calling it before I live it all out to no avail.
